== Ingredients ==
* 1 boneless [[Cookbook:Pork#Loin|pork loin]] roast
* [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|Cider vinegar]], as needed
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Chop Rub|chop rub]]
* 1 sprig [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 5 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* [[Cookbook:Cooking Spray|Non-stick cooking spray]]

== Procedure ==
#Generously [[Cookbook:Brush|brush]] pork with cider vinegar. Apply chop rub, pressing slightly to aid adhesion. Spray with non-stick cooking spray. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.
#Place rosemary in the bottom of a roasting pan and place garlic in a circle around it. Place pork on top. Some may wish to be a bit bolder and make slits in the meat to insert the rosemary and garlic into the roast.
#Insert an oven-safe probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into the center and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
#Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.

steps.text: Generously brush pork with cider vinegar. Apply chop rub, pressing slightly to aid adhesion. Spray with non-stick cooking spray. Refrigerate at least 1 hour.

Place rosemary in the bottom of a roasting pan and place garlic in a circle around it. Place pork on top. Some may wish to be a bit bolder and make slits in the meat to insert the rosemary and garlic into the roast.
Insert an oven-safe probe thermometer into the center and bake at 375°F until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Remove and let rest for 10 minutes. Serve.
